name: show_hud_text
description: Display a TEXT NOTE widget on the user's HUD with specific content. Use when the user asks you to write something on screen, pin a note, show a reminder, or display text visibly alongside the interface.

parameters.description: The full text body to display in the widget. Extract or compose the text the user wants shown on screen.
Optional short title shown in the widget header, e.g. 'REMINDER', 'NOTE', 'TODO'. Omit if the user didn't specify one.
